scripts.start-server: npm --workspace client run build && NODE_ENV=production node server/index.js
scripts.start-server-win: npm --workspace client run build && SET NODE_ENV=production && node server/index.js
scripts.update: git pull && npm install && npm run start-server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "node --watch server/index.js" "npm --workspace client start"
